To measure exactly 45 minutes using two non-uniform ropes that each burn in 60 minutes, follow these steps:

1. **Light the first rope (R1) from both ends** and the **second rope (R2) from one end** at the same time.  
2. **R1 will burn out in 30 minutes** (since burning from both ends halves the time).  
3. At the moment R1 finishes (30 minutes elapsed), **light the other end of R2**.  
4. R2 now burns from both ends, so the remaining time (which was 30 minutes from one end) is halved to **15 minutes**.  

When R2 finishes burning, **45 minutes have passed** (30 + 15). This method works because burning from both ends ensures the remaining time is split evenly, even with non-uniform burn rates.
